free_tier_limits.correction: Basic free plan quotas are monthly: 25,000 map views; 5,000 each for static maps, place search, navigation, and elevation; and 1 custom style. It is restricted to non-commercial use on publicly available sites without login.

rate_limits.correction: Published default limits per account and IP: Maps 100 requests/second; Static Maps, Elevation, Places, and Routing 1 request/second each.

description.correction: Jawg provides raster/vector maps, geocoding, routing, static maps, place search, and elevation with access-token authentication. Its free Basic plan is limited to non-commercial use, so describing it generally as suitable for light production use is misleading.

notes: Official 2026 documentation confirms the API domain, documented endpoint, token authentication, and product set. The entry fails because Jawg publishes exact free-plan quotas and rate limits, while the description omits the free plan's non-commercial-use restriction. No definitive official CORS statement was located.
